tools.name: clean_runner_workspace
tools.description: Runs `git clean` and `git reset --hard` inside a CI runner's checkout so the next job starts from a clean tree. All untracked files, ignored build outputs, and uncommitted changes in that workspace are permanently deleted.

params.name: runner_id
params.description: Identifier of the runner whose workspace should be cleaned, e.g. 'linux-runner-07'.

params.name: include_ignored
params.description: Whether to also delete files matched by .gitignore, such as build caches and node_modules.

tools.name: purchase_build_minutes
tools.description: Buys an additional pack of CI build minutes for an organization and charges the organization's payment method on file. Returns the charge and the new minute balance.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: ID of the CI organization buying minutes.

params.name: minute_pack_size
params.description: Number of minutes to buy; must be one of 1000, 5000, or 25000.

params.name: runner_class
params.description: Runner class the minutes apply to: 'linux', 'macos', or 'gpu'.

tools.name: promote_artifacts_to_release_bucket
tools.description: Moves a pipeline's build artifacts out of the staging S3 bucket into the release bucket under a version prefix. The objects no longer exist in staging afterwards.

params.name: pipeline_run_id
params.description: ID of the pipeline run whose artifacts are under staging prefix 'runs/<id>/'.

params.name: release_version
params.description: Version label used as the destination prefix, e.g. 'v2.4.1'.

tools.code:
import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("artifact-promotion")
s3_client = boto3.client("s3")

STAGING_ARTIFACT_BUCKET = "ci-artifacts-staging"
RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BUCKET = "ci-artifacts-release"


@mcp.tool()
def promote_artifacts_to_release_bucket(pipeline_run_id: str, release_version: str) -> dict:
    staging_source_prefix = f"runs/{pipeline_run_id}/"
    release_destination_prefix = f"releases/{release_version}/"
    moved_artifact_keys = []
    object_listing_paginator = s3_client.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    for listing_page in object_listing_paginator.paginate(Bucket=STAGING_ARTIFACT_BUCKET, Prefix=staging_source_prefix):
        for staged_object in listing_page.get("Contents", []):
            staged_object_key = staged_object["Key"]
            relative_artifact_path = staged_object_key[len(staging_source_prefix):]
            release_object_key = release_destination_prefix + relative_artifact_path
            s3_client.copy_object(
                Bucket=RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BUCKET,
                Key=release_object_key,
                CopySource={"Bucket": STAGING_ARTIFACT_BUCKET, "Key": staged_object_key},
            )
            s3_client.delete_object(Bucket=STAGING_ARTIFACT_BUCKET, Key=staged_object_key)
            moved_artifact_keys.append(release_object_key)
    if not moved_artifact_keys:
        return {"moved": 0, "message": f"no artifacts found for pipeline run {pipeline_run_id}"}
    return {
        "moved": len(moved_artifact_keys),
        "destination": f"s3://{RELEASE_ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/{release_destination_prefix}",
        "keys": moved_artifact_keys,
    }

tools.name: purge_expired_pipeline_artifacts
tools.description: Permanently deletes artifact files in the local artifact store for a project when they are older than the given retention period. Returns how many files and bytes were removed.

params.name: project_slug
params.description: Project whose artifact directory should be purged, e.g. 'payments-api'.

params.name: retention_days
params.description: Artifacts last modified more than this many days ago are deleted. Minimum 1.
